stack.name: Stack
stack.blurb: Numbered cards descending, a dashed connector drawing between each one. Motion carries the sequence: card lands, connector draws, next card lands.
stack.best: a process or pipeline. "The five steps to X". The default when the content is genuinely ordered.

ambient.name: Ambient
ambient.blurb: Every word is on screen at every instant. Nothing enters, nothing exits. The motion is decoration only: a scan line, breathing card borders, orbiting accent dots, a shimmer across the headline.
ambient.best: the feed. A viewer landing mid-loop reads the whole thing immediately, which no sequential variant can promise. Use it when the copy matters more than the choreography.

flow.name: Flow
flow.blurb: Stages stepping down and across, each connector drawing and then sending a dot along it. Reads faster than a straight stack and holds fewer steps.
flow.best: input to transform to output. Three or four stages, not six.

hub.name: Hub
hub.blurb: One centre, five satellites, spokes drawing outward in sequence with a dot running each one.
hub.best: architecture and "one X, many Y". Not for a sequence: a hub says the satellites are peers.

versus.name: Versus
versus.blurb: Dim left column, accent right column, rows revealing in pairs, the centre rule drawing itself top to bottom.
versus.best: old way against new way. The comparison does the arguing, so the copy can stay blunt.

layers.name: Layers
layers.blurb: Horizontal bands stacking bottom-up, each with a fill bar, on a solid base block.
layers.best: a stack diagram or maturity ladder, where the order means "sits on top of" rather than "happens after".
